intent: An operator setting several candidates per round gets a start estimate that stays right for any number of candidates, because the statistic it multiplies is the cost of one call.
observable_outcome: A K = 3 round with reported costs writes one cost event listing three call costs, and the batch_reflection statistics count three samples for it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A debit of three reported calls is one cost_events row and three samples in its statistics window.
A window of single-call events gives the same samples and percentiles as before.
A list of one call, calls not summing to the debit, a negative call or calls on an estimated event are refused.
